pages.text: With the right ritual, a boss of another world can be called up to serve you, and Goety's Redstone Monstrosity can be cast in metals other than redstone.$(br2)Each boss comes from its own mod, and its pages appear in this book only when that mod is installed.

pages.title: Bound Bosses
pages.text: $(bold)Who needs what$()$(br)$(li)Mira Monstrosity ($(italic)meowhem$())$(li)Captain Cornelia ($(italic)Aquamirae$())$(li)Void Blossom and Night Lich ($(italic)Bosses of Mass Destruction$())$(li)Old Champion and Returning Knight ($(italic)Marium's Soulslike Weaponry$())$(li)Netherman ($(italic)Knights Quest$())$(br2)The seven $(l:goetybossservants/monstrosities/material_monstrosities)Material Monstrosities$() need nothing but Goety.

pages.title: Servitude
pages.text: Bound bosses are servants like any other. The Dark Wand orders them to follow, wander, stay or guard; they fight whatever you fight, and never turn on you, your allies or your pets.$(br2)They break no blocks unless the server allows it, and only one of each boss summoned by ritual will serve you at a time; the Mira Monstrosity, built in a mold, may serve two at once.

pages.title: Souls
pages.text: A fallen boss summoned by ritual leaves its soul behind. Set the soul on a Dark Altar as the activation item, with nothing on the pedestals, and the boss rises again for 500 souls.$(br2)It then serves whoever performed the ritual.$(br2)The Mira Monstrosity leaves its head instead, as the monstrosities do.
